verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a scheduled 'monitor website changes' feature that watches a page, sitemap, or dataset and emits signed change events on a schedule — a concrete recurring job. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduler (e.g., scheduling arbitrary scrapes, crawls, or extraction pipelines) beyond this single monitoring use case. Missing for 10: broader scheduling of arbitrary workflows/jobs (not just change-monitoring), a job management UI/API for recurring tasks, and independent confirmation of the monitor feature working in practice.
